devkitSMS source snapshot
https://github.com/sverx/devkitSMS
Commit: b172c7433ff690136fee47504a5fd427f62f2d16

SMSlib.h and SMSlib source are from this same snapshot. Do not mix different
headers or calling conventions. This port's Makefile compiles the required
SMSlib modules and assembles crt0_sms.s with the active SDCC toolchain.
The verified build uses SDCC 4.5.0. No precompiled library is needed.

SMSlib and ihx2sms: public domain / Unlicense.
CRT: GPL-2.0-or-later with the SDCC linking special exception in its header.
See LICENSE-SMSlib, LICENSE-ihx2sms, COPYING.txt, LICENSES.txt and source headers.

The original skill snapshot also supplied prebuilt artifacts. They are not
used by this Makefile and are omitted from the distributable source archive.
This port uses its own PSG driver and does not link PSGlib.
